question: Which of the following was enacted in 1988 with the aim of ensuring environmental stability and maintenance of ecological balance which is vital for the sustenance of all life forms, human, animal and plant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Forest Policy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Forest Policy 1988** focuses primarily on** forest preservation, conservation, and development.**
 
• The key themes of the National Forest Policy 1988 were the preservation and restoration of ecological equilibrium, as well as the protection of forests as national heritages containing numerous types of flora and animals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• ** National Forest Policy 1988:**

 
 
• The primary thing of the 1988 National Forest Policy is to save environmental stability and the conservation of ecological balance, especially atmospheric equilibrium, which is essential for the survival of all life forms, humans, creatures, and shops.
 
• A series of legislation aimed at perfecting environmental quality has been legislated in India.
 
• The Wildlife Protection Act of 1972, the Water Act of 1974, the Air Act of 1981, the Forest Conservation Act of 1980, and the Environment Protection Act of 1986 were all approved by the Indian Parliament.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Biological Diversity Act:**

 
 
• The Biological Diversity Act, of 2002 was passed by the congress of India to cover biodiversity and grease the sustainable operation of natural coffers with the original communities.
 
• The Act was legislated to meet the conditions quested by the United Nations Convention on Biological Diversity( CBD), to which India is a party.
 
 
 
• **Environment (Protection) Rules:**
 
 
• This act was passed under composition 253( legislation for giving effect to transnational agreements).
 
• It was legislated to achieve the UN conference on the mortal terrain, 1972- Stockholm protestation.
 
 
 
• **National Environmental Tribunal Act:**
 
 
• The National Environment Tribunal Act was legislated by the congress on 17th June 1995, India faces numerous environmental issues due to the growing population as the population is the major cause not only of environmental decline by causing pollution but also acts as major participation in environmental accidents.
